notes:
Backgrounds from the gallery can go straight into Corylus. Open a background on the gallery page, choose «Add to Corylus», and Corylus shows you the preview, its size, credit and licence, and asks before it downloads anything.

Settings → Writing & Focus lists your downloaded backgrounds under «My backgrounds», with their total size. Use any of them again or remove the ones you no longer want.

Saving a custom background now writes the file safely in one step, like every other file Corylus writes.
